answered.sql: SELECT E.employee_name, E.position, PO.owner_name AS past_owner FROM Employees E JOIN Healthcare_Facilities H ON E.healthcare_facility_id = H.id LEFT JOIN Past_Owners PO ON H.past_owner_id = PO.id

candidates.meaning: Show all employee names, their positions, and the founding year of the healthcare facility they work for.
candidates.sql: SELECT e.employee_name, e.position, f.founding_year FROM Employees e JOIN Healthcare_Facilities h ON e.healthcare_facility_id = h.id JOIN Founding_Year f ON h.founding_id = f.id

candidates.meaning: Show the names, positions, and the founding year of the healthcare facilities where employees work.
candidates.sql: SELECT E.employee_name, E.position, F.founding_year FROM Employees E JOIN Healthcare_Facilities F ON E.healthcare_facility_id = F.id

candidates.meaning: Display the names, positions, and the past owner of the healthcare facilities where employees are employed.
candidates.sql: SELECT E.employee_name, E.position, PO.owner_name FROM Employees E JOIN Healthcare_Facilities F ON E.healthcare_facility_id = F.id JOIN Past_Owners PO ON F.past_owner_id = PO.id

candidates.meaning: List the names, positions, and the acquisition year of the past owners of the healthcare facilities where employees are based.
candidates.sql: SELECT E.employee_name, E.position, PO.acquisition_year FROM Employees E JOIN Healthcare_Facilities F ON E.healthcare_facility_id = F.id JOIN Past_Owners PO ON F.past_owner_id = PO.id
